source.authentication: host-only Bearer token; token not persisted

assumptions: The account contained exactly $10 before this billing window.
No unrelated Pod, Serverless, storage, tax, credit adjustment, or charge exists outside the queried billing records.
The REST billing records had fully posted when queried.
credit_estimate.exact_balance_source: RunPod Billing console or `runpodctl user`; the current REST OpenAPI exposes usage history but not clientBalance.

post_terminal_waste_estimate.basis: Attempt-L Pod billing time minus elapsed time from Pod creation to the final terminal export timestamp.
post_terminal_waste_estimate.classification: calculated estimate from provider billing, not a separately itemized RunPod charge

limitations: The network-volume billing endpoint did not attribute every amount to an attempt in this receipt.
The current account balance was not returned by the REST API, so estimated remaining credit is not an exact ledger balance.
Post-terminal waste is an attribution calculation; RunPod reported total time and amount, not a terminal-versus-post-terminal split.
